payload.core_composition_summary: Segment array by locked indices, then DP (LIS) with binary search on ordered list to count min changes.
payload.rationale: Segmentation and LIS DP are the core, while bisect (ordered set) optimizes the DP, forming a composition of dynamic programming and data structures.
